comment: Quantize every non-MoE Kimi-K3 text Linear, including lm_head, attention projections and the dense first-layer MLP, to GGML Q4_K. Non-Linear tensors retain their model-declared dtype.
Keep the 128-input KDA f_b projection in BF16 because GGML K-quants require complete 256-value blocks within every matrix row.
Quantize all Kimi-K3 MoE Linear weights, including the router, latent projections, shared experts and routed experts, to GGML Q2_K.
